```{r}
pak::pak("jrosell/jrrosell")
pkgload::load_all()
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(jrrosell)
library(ggtext)
theme_set_roboto_darkblue()
```

```{r}
flights <- import_flights()
carrier_lookup <- import_carriers()

flights_summary <- flights |>
  filter(near(year, 2025)) |>
  mutate(
    ArrDel15 = ifelse(arr_delay >= 15, "Delayed", "On Time"),
    Cancelled = ifelse(cancelled == 1, "Cancelled", "Not Cancelled")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Status = case_when(
      Cancelled == "Cancelled" ~ "Cancelled",
      ArrDel15 == "Delayed" ~ "Delayed",
      TRUE ~ "On Time"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(carrier, Status) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(carrier) |>
  mutate(
    fraction = n / sum(n),
    ontime_fraction = fraction[Status == "On Time"]
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(carrier_lookup, by = c("carrier" = "Code")) |>
  mutate(carrier = coalesce(Description, carrier)) |>
  mutate(
    Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Cancelled", "Delayed", "On Time")),
    carrier = fct_reorder(carrier, ontime_fraction)
  ) |>
  glimpse()
```

```{r}
p <- flights_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = carrier, y = fraction, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.95) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparing airlines by flight status",
    subtitle = "What are the airlines with better %on-time flights in the U.S. (2025)",
    x = "",
    y = "",
    fill = "",
    caption = "Data source: Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance from transtats.bts.gov\nAuthor: Jordi Rosell (@jrosell)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#1b9e77")
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(8, "pt"),
    legend.key.height = unit(8, "pt"),
    legend.key.spacing.x = unit(16, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 25, margin = margin(5, 0, 5, 0)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      color = "gray40",
      lineheight = 0.5,
      margin = margin(t = 0, r = 8, b = 0, l = 0)
    )
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  coord_flip()

p
```
